scope: Every original and added SC field individually reviewed: Ethernet transport separated from SC/APDU/BVLC sizes, URI/UUID/VMAC identity, native conditional timers, mutual TLS and 2021 cryptographic baseline. All-field validation, header dependency checks, storage preservation and foreign IP-field rejection tested; frontend conditional proposals support number and select controls.
